overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the University of Oklahoma women's gymnastics team on winning the 2026 NCAA national championship, the eighth national title in the program's history. It notes the team's 35-1-1 record, its conference and regional titles, and individual national championships won by two of its gymnasts. The resolution recognizes the team's hard work and congratulates the athletes on their season. It is ceremonial and does not change any law. The Senate agreed to it by unanimous consent on May 12, 2026.
for: Supporters say it is fitting for the Senate to honor college athletes and coaches for a historic national championship season.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
